_comment: Invented curves, not a measurement: measure your own loops. Copy to curves.json and upload with flowcheck.py. A key is 'NAME IDX': NAME of --controller NAME=HOST, IDX the valve number; a key of another controller is skipped. curve: 2..16 points [pulses from the closed end stop, l/min], pulses increasing, flow not falling. Optional: strokeCounts (required to enable the layer), refSide (closed or open), qmax, offset, gain. The --sim controllers are sim-a and sim-b.
